name: Mi Air Purifier 3C
measure_description: Measured in favorite mode with an IKEA GRILLPLATS Matter plug read through a Home Assistant power sensor (0.1 W resolution). Fan speed was set in 5-10 % steps; each value is the stable power draw at that speed (5 % = 392 rpm, 100 % = 2204 rpm). Display and LED were left in their default state.
